_comment: Reviewed names the innerHTML audit (scripts/html-escape-audit.js, #89) trusts: calls = functions / methods whose result is safe in HTML, names = plain variables, properties = .x on anything. Add one only after checking every place it is used holds what the reason says.

calls.encodeURIComponent: percent-encodes < > " & (not ' : never inside a quoted JS string in a handler attribute)
calls.formatRate: a number formatted as a rate
calls.icon: ui/icons.js: constant sprite <svg> markup; every call passes a constant name (icon-sprite.test.js)
calls.moneyHtml: ui/components.js: formatRupees text of a number, HTML-escaped, in constant .money / .cur spans
calls.moneyInText: ui/components.js: the text HTML-escaped, with its formatRupees figure drawn by moneyHtml
